508e2f5fb0946e06a19312b96eb9fbd431db3a17:
query FlxCertificateVerify($code: String!) {
  flxCertificateVerify(code: $code) {
    status
    title
    holderName
    number
    issuedOn {
      iso
      label
    }
    issuer
    code
    pageUrl
    pdfUrl
    imageUrl
    imageWidth
    imageHeight
    ogTitle
    ogDescription
  }
}
5202dd61eff74bf72a989d2e9fddce08d68cc94a:
query FlxCertificateOne($id: Int!) {
  flxCertificate(id: $id) {
    ...FlxCertificateRow
  }
}

fragment FlxCertificateRow on FlxCertificate {
  id
  databaseId
  number
  status
  title
  holderName
  code
  pageUrl
  pdfUrl
  imageUrl
  views
  backdated
  createdAt {
    label
  }
  eventId
  eventName
  templateId
  templateName
  referrerId
  referrerName
  createdByName
  canEdit
  values
  person {
    id
    databaseId
    name
    email
    phone {
      e164
      digits
      display
    }
  }
  deliveries {
    channel
    sent
    failed
    waiting
  }
}
